gen-gf-alkalami-fs-bespoke-sans: Alkalami sounds bookish and literary, its weight shifting like stretched rubber cord. But Bespoke Sans, the sans-serif body, is sharp and refined, with low variation and generous space at curve ends.
gen-gf-almarai-fs-literata: Wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine give Almarai a modern, no-fuss look. Literata, the classic serif, settles into paragraphs with sturdy thin lines, slightly heavier thick ones and wide, unclosed mouths.
gen-gf-alyamama-fs-bespoke-sans: Refined and bookish, Alyamama has generous curve openings and horizontals slightly slimmer than its verticals. Bespoke Sans feels sharper beside it, a sans with low contrast that lets the serif's gentle stress stand out.
gen-gf-amaranth-fs-literata: Modern and contemporary, Amaranth keeps its lines plain, while the serif Literata adds a moderate thickness shift you feel more than see. Amaranth earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-amarna-fs-literata: Literata reads sophisticated and bookish, with wide, unclosed curves. Amarna draws flat, contrast-free letters with cupped rounds, while the classic serif keeps only slight brush pressure that carries a paragraph along.
gen-gf-amethysta-fs-bespoke-sans: Quiet authority in serif form: Amethysta's modest stroke contrast feels refined. Bespoke Sans, the plain sans, stays low in contrast, sharing the page without crowding the heading's subtle modulation.
gen-gf-amiri-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and traditional, Amiri packs its glyphs into a dense huddle, with restful, modest swings in stroke weight. Bespoke Sans, the sans-serif, is the sharper one, with low contrast and generous space beside curves.
gen-gf-ancizar-sans-fs-literata: Literata is a sophisticated, bookish serif, its thin lines only slightly slimmer than the stems. But Ancizar Sans runs clenched and close-fitted, adding a tighter, more professional edge on the page.
gen-gf-ancizar-serif-fs-bespoke-sans: Quietly bookish: Ancizar Serif curves in without ink pooling, with light contrast between verticals and curves. Bespoke Sans handles the sharper side, a sans with low contrast and generous space at curve ends.
gen-gf-andada-pro-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified, with open-arc c forms and slightly thinner joins. Shrink Andada Pro and its understated stroke variation fades, whereas Bespoke Sans, the plain sans, stays sharp when enlarged.
